provenance.walkthrough: 00:15–01:25 studio open: host welcomes, Shay Given and Ellen White introduced, four games trailed, transfer window billed for the end; hands to Stamford Bridge with Jonathan Pearce named as commentator. | Chelsea v Brighton — handover 01:25, commentary and pitchside interviews (Alonso, Hurzeler, Chelsea player) run to 13:15; studio analysis of Alonso's system, wing-backs, Martinez 13:15–18:45. | Manchester United v Ipswich — studio setup 18:45 ("after defeat at Hull last week...Commentary comes from Steven Wyeth"), commentary 19:00 to interviews with Carrick, O'Neil and Bruno Fernandes ending 30:08; studio analysis of Bruno, Rashford/Mainoo and the Maguire handball/own-goal law 30:08–35:57. | Leeds United v Brentford — studio setup 35:57 ("Next, Leeds and Brentford...Alistair Mann was at Elland Road"), commentary 36:05 through to manager/player interviews ending 45:19; studio analysis of Brentford's first half, Farke's changes and the Brentford penalty shout 45:19–49:34. | Sunderland v Fulham — studio setup 49:34 ("Vicki Sparks was at the Stadium of Light"), commentary from 49:49 including Le Bris, Arbeloa and Isidor interviews to roughly 57:28; studio analysis of the substitutes, Mukiele and Arbeloa's comments 57:28–61:04. | 61:04 host throws to the rest of the weekend's goals: Crystal Palace v Manchester City round-up 61:14–62:05 (Haaland, Cherki, Foden, Donnarumma own goal); Liverpool v Nottingham Forest 62:05–62:37 (Ndoye, Isak, Forest penalty, Munoz); Bournemouth v Everton 62:37–63:03 (Scott, Tarkowski late equaliser); Coventry City v Hull City 63:03–63:15 (Liam Millar winner); Tottenham v Newcastle 63:15–63:33 (Elanga, Wissa). | 63:33 onwards: iPlayer/Monday Night Club plugs, transfer deadline discussion with the BBC's transfer correspondent, league table and sign-off to 68:57. No further match footage.
